c: Press Fix and fill the Cause notes and Fix notes.
say: When the cause is known, press fix, and fill in the cause notes and fix notes.

c: If the fix changes a system, raise a change from the form menu.
say: If the fix changes a system, raise a normal, standard or emergency change from the form menu.

c: Communicate Fix puts the fix notes on linked incidents.
say: Communicate fix puts the fix notes on the linked incidents.

c: When the fix is in, press Resolve; the code is Fix Applied.
say: When the fix is in, press resolve. The code is fix applied.

c: Incidents on hold for the problem are resolved and their callers told. Only linked ones stay with their teams.
say: Incidents on hold, awaiting the problem, are resolved now, and their callers are told. Incidents that are only linked stay with their teams.

c: Once the fix has proved itself, Complete closes the problem and cancels open tasks.
say: Once the fix has proved itself, press complete. The problem closes, and open problem tasks are canceled.
